parameters.content:
## Receive and validate
Header Auth credential is required before activation. Timestamp must be within ±300 seconds. Books and totals are validated; statuses are recomputed from dates. No real email is sent.

## Important: sequential-demo guard
Static data is a secondary server-side guard, not an atomic lock. Exact request IDs are remembered for 24 hours after successful workflow executions; an author is throttled for 60 seconds. Static data does not persist in manual tests or after failed executions, and may race across concurrent executions. Bubble must create and guard NotificationLog first. Do not claim concurrent exactly-once processing. Replace with an atomic unique-key store before production.

## Generate and return
OpenRouter credential must use a newly configured key, never the exposed portfolio key. Provider receives only the allowlisted author/book data, without email or phone. Failure never becomes a fake Success. Callback URL is fixed; payloads cannot choose another destination. Three attempts per HTTP node; callback errors fail the execution visibly. Execution-data saving is OFF because incoming webhook headers include the shared secret. Bubble NotificationLog and the safe error audit retain operational results. Keep this draft inactive until Bubble authentication, terminal-state guards and stale handling are verified.
